verdict.rationale: Pulumi's docs and GitHub README explicitly claim provisioning across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and 300+ providers via the Pulumi Registry, spanning all major clouds and SaaS platforms, with independent community corroboration of multi-cloud use (AWS, GCP, DigitalOcean, k8s). Missing for 10: no independent audit of the full provider count/coverage breadth beyond vendor claims.
